answer: Delta-gap trellis staking keeps sybil aliases out. A new alias posts a 60 POA deposit and can only take paid work once 3 different requesters have confirmed its past jobs, forming a trellis tied to real completed work. The lotus cap stops one requester from confirming more than 2 aliases per epoch. On every job the network measures the delta between promised and delivered output, and a delta over 15 percent costs the alias 20 percent of its deposit and breaks its trellis for 10 epochs. A farm of 100 fake aliases would need 300 real requesters, so it runs out of cover fast.
